scope: Published Unity v2, Unit Sampling v1 and Collision Calculus v1; bounded computational counterparts, not whole-theorem formalization.

projection.domain: detector N=2..100 and transport N=2..8; full infinite native Gram at 256 bits, with additional guard bits for larger directed solves; kernel indices 2..64
projection.proof_boundary: Finite projections, shallow readings, signed commutator and terminal response, complete costs and coefficients. Purity, eventual eligibility, infinite-dimensional decompositions and divergent capture require the written argument.

probe_transport.domain: cutoff N=2..8, paired eligible depths h and h+2 at 4N, complete native frame through 16N
probe_transport.proof_boundary: Complete directed projections compare the independently constructed probes, signed optimizer drift and every old/new/lost Gram entry. The all-scale transport theorem remains the written statement.

carry.domain: denominator 2..10000, address 0..1000000, at most 16 radix factors 2..36
carry.proof_boundary: Exact finite carry telescoping retains the terminal remainder. No infinite carry limit is inferred.

detail.domain: cutoff 2..512; exact odd Jordan and Mobius coefficients and complete error interval
detail.proof_boundary: The admitted lift and transverse covariance are reconstructed from coefficients. Orthogonality and all-scale bounds remain the stated identities.

correction.domain: nonnegative exact rational response norm and error; positive rational cost
correction.proof_boundary: Conditional gain allowance; supplied error and cost bounds are assumptions, not estimated from a truncated field.

masks.domain: copy ratio/count 2..10000/1..10000; polarity base 2..36; numerical conditioned masks 2<=first<last<=200, base 2..10
masks.proof_boundary: Complete-period numerical capture uses reported rank tolerance. It is separate from directed interval output. Sharp infinite-copy cost is a written theorem; finite Gram sums are evaluated.

packet.domain: scale 2..4 for complete directed native energies; exact coefficient API scale 2..128
packet.proof_boundary: Whole-norm signed work and a coarse global envelope are computed. The analytic envelope U, its supremum, growth floor and recovery equivalences are not estimated by a finite prefix.

divisor.domain: scale 1..128, odd core <=16*scale, address <=10000; work cutoff 8*scale..10000
divisor.proof_boundary: Exact family profiles, joined resets, parent credit and four-reading lower bounds; the complete omitted change is enclosed. Screening and large-primitive asymptotics stay analytic. No all-scale sign is inferred.

mass.domain: positive node coordinates and tree cutoffs 1..240; the published primitive kernel uses coprime nodes
mass.proof_boundary: The tree uses pair mass 1/(ab(a+b)), twice the paper kernel. Divide node loss and total/frontier masses by two; multiplying node loss by (a+b)/2 gives the conserved period mass. The total infinite measure and conditioning retain the written proof.

sampling.domain: prime carry inspection through 251; sampled tables through 10007; shifted clock grids N<=120, q<=10000, rational shift denominator<=10000
sampling.proof_boundary: Exact grids and the finite three-channel correction. The published v1 unit-defect rate is analytic; later local draft exponents are outside this scope.

source.domain: source N,k<=512, signed Q<=1000000; completion k<=120; rectangle sides<=120; shells N<=120; interior prime 257..997
source.proof_boundary: Literal signed counts, modular inverses, cyclic variation, Dedekind kernels, shell coefficients and the two-index witness. Uniform sums, prime distribution and the prescribed scalar pairing are not certified.

descent.domain: prime decomposition through 251; stopped denominators and prefixes<=512; literal phase window endpoints 2..512
descent.proof_boundary: All signs, terminal costs and endpoint phases are retained. Counts and fixed derivative ranges are finite; small/large-block estimates and uniform power saving remain analytic.

grid.domain: q<=10000; <=16 complex rational fields/segments; clocks frequency<=120, total<=512; harmonics integer frequencies +/-10000 and shift 0 or 1/2
grid.proof_boundary: Exact point readings, traces, combined resets, overlap and regular curvature for piecewise affine fields; exact harmonic aliasing. General piecewise C2 hypotheses and convergence remain written statements.

work.domain: <=256 complex rational readings; nonnegative observation weights; native cycle cutoff<=1000000 and period<=256
work.proof_boundary: Finite observation changes and both endpoints are exact. Complete periodic native tails are directed intervals. Tail allowances are conditional on the supplied global envelopes; arbitrary BV and growing-signal limits are analytic.

invariants.domain: 1..8 independent complex rational rows, <=256 addresses, positive rational weights
invariants.proof_boundary: Exact Hermitian constrained minimum for the supplied readings. The permitted addition space must actually be annihilated by those readings.

register.domain: <=16 residue components and <=256 nonnegative observation weights; complex rational signed amplitudes
register.proof_boundary: Exact ordered intersections and both cross orientations. Divisor-growth and smoothing estimates require their hypotheses; finite counts do not establish uniform constants.

shells.domain: 1..256 signed rational primitive values, or square prefixes with --from-prefixes
shells.proof_boundary: Exact forward and reverse shell readings, full prefix reconstruction and formal prime-log coefficients. This inversion does not supply an asymptotic recovery bound.

prefix_population.domain: 2<=first<=last<=512; all admissible words of length at least two, both determinant orientations
prefix_population.proof_boundary: Complete finite top rows, reconstructed words and orientation counts. Infinite endpoint limits retain the written proof.

stopped_cost.domain: modulus 2..512, threshold 1..modulus; all residues including nonunits
stopped_cost.proof_boundary: Exact interval-extension costs, signed cyclic jumps, variation and the finite bound. The all-modulus estimate and completion argument remain analytic.

component_matrices.domain: --matrix on the existing admitted component domains; all complex entries, at most 16 components
component_matrices.proof_boundary: Continuous and sampled Hermitian Grams, signed defect and clock/pulse boundary matrices. General change-of-coordinates and infinite limits retain their written arguments.
